bun run audit:ci (scripts/audit-check.js) spawns bun --version and fails closed with 'Bun runtime does not match the repository version authority' on this host's bun 1.4.0. To run it locally: npx -y -p bun@1.3.5 bun --version (downloads the pinned bun into the npx cache), find its bun.exe under ~/AppData/Local/npm-cache/_npx/*/node_modules/@oven/bun-windows-x64-baseline/bin, put THAT directory (POSIX form) first on PATH, then bun run audit:ci. The sh shim in node_modules/.bin is not enough because spawnSync resolves bun.exe, not the shim. Verified 2026-09-05.
